questions.question: What should the website include?
questions.recommendedChoice: Build responsive Home, About Us, Activities, Join Our Community, and Contact pages for Her Next Life, a supportive community for mothers aged 40+. Use the supplied brand images and brand copy, including “Wellness • Friendship • A Brighter Tomorrow” and “A supportive community for mothers aged 40+ to stay active, connected and happy!” Apply the supplied brand palette (forest green, vivid pink, warm ivory, with restrained coral accents) and a premium editorial visual style. Include activities such as yoga, virtual meetups, celebrations, creative workshops, and wellness sessions; show “Coming Soon” for schedules and pricing instead of inventing dates, times, or prices. Include an accessible, validated community registration form and the Contact page Google Form https://forms.gle/awLbZv3hxzHpvfB28. Reuse only the email address and social links supplied by the user. Keep the site deployable to GitHub Pages with no backend, paid APIs, or paid dependencies. Registration destination still needs confirmation because a static GitHub Pages site cannot receive or store submissions on its own.

questions.question: Where should community registration submissions go? GitHub Pages cannot process or store them without a form endpoint.
questions.recommendedChoice: Use a free Google Form for registration; provide its URL. Keep the website itself static and submit registrations directly to that form.
questions.answer: Use a free Google Form for registration; provide its URL. Keep the website itself static and submit registrations directly to that form.
questions.rationale: The brief requires a working registration form but only provides a Google Forms URL for Contact. A static frontend alone cannot deliver or persist submissions.
